title: NTI Final Project
summary: Eight modules taken end to end: Terraform infrastructure, Ansible configuration, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, a Jenkins pipeline, and an observability stack.
why: Structured as a course rather than a repository: each module is a numbered directory with its own README, so it can be followed in order without reading the whole thing first. It is the closest thing here to a guided path.
author: waleed
summaryAr: ثماني وحدات من البداية إلى النهاية: بنية تحتية بـ Terraform، وتهيئة بـ Ansible، و Docker، و Kubernetes، و Helm، وخط Jenkins، ومنظومة مراقبة.
